decisions.statement: The rename is left to the mechanical change renaming a page.
The kind of page is read from the path rather than from the index.
A page type is refused here.
The refusal names the change renaming a page type.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: a page renamed and carried to where its slug says, in the data and in every name
